content.stem: 以下哪一项描述了金融情报机构(FIU)在进行跨境洗钱调查时正式的信息共享与合作方式？

options.A: 金融行动特别工作组(FATF)、欧洲委员会打击洗钱组织(MONEYVAL)及其他作为金融情报机构联络点的区域机构
options.B: 沃尔夫斯堡集团作为金融情报机构的沟通平台
options.C: 反洗钱金融情报机构之间为建立结构化信息共享而签订的谅解备忘录(MOU)
options.D: 相互法律协助条约（MLATs），允许金融情报机构请求逮捕和获取证据

content.stem_en: Which of the following describes a formal method of information sharing and cooperation between Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) when conducting cross-border money laundering investigations?

options_en.A: FATF, MONEYVAL, and other regional bodies acting as a contact point for FIUs
options_en.B: The Wolfsberg Group serving as a communication platform for FIUs
options_en.C: Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) between FIUs establishing structured information sharing
options_en.D: Mutual Legal Assistance Treaties (MLATs) allowing FIUs to request arrests and evidence
